title: Dyadic fNIRS hyperscanning: experimental paradigms and what they reveal about interbrain synchrony
title_zh: 双人功能近红外超扫描：实验范式及其揭示的脑间同步性
abstract: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) hyperscanning enables the simultaneous measurement of the brain activities of various individuals performing shared or interactive tasks and estimating their interbrain synchrony (IBS). IBS is believed to reflect different mechanisms, including social bonding or mutual prediction, and to be modulated by various factors, such as familiarity or the experimental paradigm. In this systematic review, we assessed fNIRS hyperscanning studies conducted until January 2026, focusing on the experimental protocols and their relation to reported IBS findings. Specifically, we aimed to understand task dependence of IBS results and how they differ between different kinds of dyad compositions. Additionally, we investigated other parameters, including IBS metrics and the association between IBS and psychological, behavioral, and physiological measures. We reviewed a total of 206 studies, revealing a predominance of joint action task paradigms. Our findings suggest that IBS is modulated by the characteristics of dyad composition. IBS is usually higher in dyads with closer bonds, and varies with gender, although a universal pattern could not be identified. Furthermore, the study protocols employed also seem to have an influence on IBS, as participants who engage in face-to-face interactions frequently show higher IBS than those who do not. We also observed that IBS is often associated with behavioral and psychological outcomes, while the association with physiological outcomes is scarcely studied. Future research should consistently include details about dyad familiarity and sex pairings, expand to underrepresented dyads, and investigate IBS across diverse paradigms and contexts in association with other metrics.
abstract_zh: 功能近红外光谱（fNIRS）超扫描能够同时测量执行共享或交互任务的多个个体的脑活动，并估计其脑间同步性（IBS）。IBS被认为反映包括社会纽带或相互预测在内的不同机制，并受多种因素调制，如熟悉程度或实验范式。在这项系统综述中，我们评估了截至2026年1月的fNIRS超扫描研究，重点关注实验方案及其与报告的IBS结果的关系。具体而言，我们旨在了解IBS结果的任务依赖性及其在不同双人组成之间的差异。此外，我们还调查了其他参数，包括IBS指标以及IBS与心理、行为和生理指标的关联。我们共审阅了206项研究，揭示了联合动作任务范式的主导地位。我们的研究结果表明，IBS受双人组成特征的调制。与关系更紧密的双人组合中，IBS通常较高，并随性别而变化，尽管无法识别普遍模式。此外，研究所采用的方案似乎也对IBS产生影响，与不参与面对面交互的参与者相比，经常参与面对面互动的参与者往往表现出更高的IBS。我们还观察到，IBS常与行为和心理结局相关，而与生理结构的关联研究较少。未来研究应始终包含关于双人熟悉程度和性别搭配的详细信息，扩展到代表性不足的双人组合，并结合其他指标在多种范式和情境中探究IBS。
